what_happened.line: The Personnel Committee voted to accept the assistant town manager's changes to the Director of Public Works job description.
The committee left the position at its current pay grade while modifying the description; the sewer commission pays a portion of the salary.
Edits added that the position presents at town meeting and added virtual contact to the job environment wording.
Members compared the FY21 hourly range for the grade with a Bolton posting and described the two as in the same ballpark.

why_it_matters: The DPW director leads a department that handles roads and sewer, and the pay grade and qualifications set here shape who can be hired and what the salary costs.
The sewer commission pays part of the salary, so the cost is split between the town budget, mostly taxes, and sewer funds.
